and finance research. All projects live on

## Featured projects

## How to use this section

Add one block per project, with:

- a short description (one or two sentences),
- the language/stack,
- a link to the repo,
- (optional) a link to a related paper or vignette.

Example template:

```markdown
### project-name
*One-line description of what the project does and why it matters.*

**Stack:** R / Python / …
[Repository](https://github.com/contefranz/project-name) ·
[Paper](https://doi.org/...)
```

## Reproducibility

Where possible, the code that accompanies my published papers is
released alongside the working-paper version. If you are looking for
replication materials for a specific paper and cannot find them, please
[email me](mailto:francesco.grossetti@unibocconi.it).
